name: Apex International Co., Ltd.
summary: Apex International Co., Ltd. manufactures, processes, trades, and sells printed circuit boards in Singapore, Thailand, Vietnam, South Korea, Hong Kong, and internationally. The company provides single-sided, double-sided, and multi-layer printed circuit boards used in LCD TVs, set-top boxes, hard disks, printers, and multimedia equipment for automobiles. It also offers home appliances, PC-related appliances, communication appliances, and auto parts appliances. The company was founded in 2001 and is based in Grand Cayman, the Cayman Islands.
